home-hero-subtitle: Continuous vulnerability scanning and automated E2E security testing for every service your team ships.
home-features-title: Everything You Need to Stay Secure
home-features-subtitle: One platform to track dependency risks and verify your APIs are safe on every release.
home-feature-scan-desc: Upload your package.json and instantly see which dependencies carry known CVEs, with severity ratings and fix suggestions.
home-feature-e2e-desc: Playwright-powered tests check for CSRF, XSS, SQL injection, CORS misconfig, and security headers on every deployment.
home-feature-reports-desc: Real-time dashboards show vulnerability trends and test results across all your environments and services.
home-feature-alerts-desc: Get notified by email or Slack the moment a new vulnerability is detected or a security test fails.
home-feature-webhook-desc: Connect your repository and trigger scans automatically on every push — no manual steps required.
home-feature-packages-desc: Track changes to your dependency tree over time and compare snapshots to spot newly introduced risks.
home-how-subtitle: From setup to your first security report in minutes.
home-step-1-desc: Create an account, set up your company profile, and invite team members with the appropriate roles.
home-step-2-desc: Define your dev, staging, and production environments, then register each service with its base URL.
home-step-3-desc: Upload a package.json for vulnerability scanning or link your repository for automated trigger on push.
home-step-4-desc: See exactly which packages are risky and which security tests failed, then follow remediation guidance to fix them.
home-cta-subtitle: Join companies already using our platform to catch vulnerabilities before attackers do.
